## About

I am a PhD student at the [Harris School of Public Policy](https://harris.uchicago.edu/) at the University of Chicago. My research spans two broad interests at the intersection of development and behavioral economics. First, refugee welfare in low- and middle-income countries, with a focus on financial inclusion and psychosocial wellbeing. Second, demand for and access to opioids for palliative care, in settings where they are under-supplied. I am engaged with field work to shape research questions and use randomized experiments to generate evidence. My current work includes projects in South Asia and East Africa.

I also co-founded [Palliative Access Lab](https://palliativeaccesslab.org) through the [Charity Entrepreneurship Incubation Program](https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/incubation-program). Please [reach out](https://cal.com/samhsu) if you would like to meet!
